name: rocketride-discorddashboard
description: Run and supervise a Discord support bot built on the discord node

appManifest.name: Discord Dashboard
appManifest.description: Run and supervise a Discord support bot built on the discord node

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.botToke.description: Variable holding the Discord bot token. The value is the NAME of a server variable; the token itself stays encrypted on the server.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.openaiK.description: Variable holding the OpenAI key the answer pipeline uses. The value is the NAME of a server variable.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.githubT.description: Variable holding a read-only GitHub token. Only the RAG pipe's agent tools need it; the app checks it before starting that pipe. The value is the NAME of a server variable.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.qdrantH.description: Variable holding the Qdrant host for the eval-capture store. Only the capture pipe needs it; the app checks it before starting that branch. The value is the NAME of a server variable.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.slackWe.description: Variable holding the Slack incoming-webhook URL the agent pages on the first escalation in a thread. Only the Slack-paging pipe needs it; use a test webhook while testing. The value is the NAME of a server variable.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.dbProvi.description: Which database node holds the dashboard's data. db_postgres connects to the host below; rocketride_sql uses your provisioned RocketRide cloud database and ignores the host, name, user and password settings.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.dbHost.description: host:port of the dashboard's Postgres. db_postgres only. The default is the local rr-discord-pg container — see the app README.

mithilesh_clock.discordDashboard.dbPassw.description: Variable holding the database password. The value is the NAME of a server variable; the password itself stays encrypted on the server. db_postgres only.
